# Version 4.155.1
> **Upstream m155 fixes** · Released November 13, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.155.1) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.155.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.155.1/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.1 picks up the latest upstream Skia m155 bug fixes without changing managed APIs.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Latest Skia m155 fixes** — The native engine moves to the newest upstream chrome/m155 commit, bringing its bug fixes into this servicing release. ([#5701](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5701))

## Platform

- **Reviewed Windows ANGLE resource compilation** — The Windows ANGLE build uses a reviewed resource-compiler script instead of downloading Chromium's prebuilt rc.exe. This changes only how the native binaries are built. ([#5587](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5587))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.1

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
